title: Scheduled & Ad‑Hoc Customer Usage Exports (CSV/S3 + Webhook Delivery)
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Goal: Provide customers with reliable, auditable exports of per-organization usage metrics via scheduled CSV deliveries (S3 presigned URL), on-demand downloads, and webhook push endpoints. Exports must support filtering by org_id, time range, product/route, and aggregation granularity (hourly/daily). Deliverables include: 1) backend worker to assemble export manifests and multipart CSVs, 2) presigned S3 upload/profile for storage and short-lived download URLs, 3) webhook delivery path with HMAC SHA256 signing and idempotency, 4) export status API and audit trail, 5) scheduling UI hooks (console) and API for on-demand exports, 6) observability and retry semantics. Requirements: - CSV format: header row with stable column ordering; UTF-8; dates in ISO-8601 UTC; token/embedding counts as numeric columns. - Also support compressed CSV (.csv.gz) when payload > 50MB. - Lifetime: presigned download links TTL 24h by default, configurable per-tenant. - Retention: export artifacts cleaned after 90 days unless tenant opts for longer retention; audit records retained 3 years. - Webhook delivery: POST to customer URL with JSON body containing export_manifest and download_url; include X-Redwood-Export-Signature: HMAC_SHA256(hex) computed over body using tenant export_key. - Retry policy: exponential backoff up to 5 attempts for 5xx and network errors; 4xx are considered permanent failures (unless 429 -> retry with Backoff-After header). - Rate limiting: per-tenant concurrent export limit default 3; schedule queue exposes SLA and estimated completion time. - Backfill: support a backfill job that can generate historical exports without blocking real-time pipeline. - Security: export_key rotation endpoint, audit log on every dispatch, RBAC: only admin org users can create scheduled exports. - Monitoring: metrics exports_total, exports_succeeded, exports_failed_by_reason, average_manifest_generation_ms, webhook_retries, s3_upload_latency; alert on >2% failure rate sustained for 15m. - Data schema: columns mapped to canonical usage schema maintained in ENG-9201, exporter validates schema version before assembling CSV. - Migration: existing ad-hoc download endpoints deprecated after rollout; migration path includes a compatibility flag for 8 weeks.
acceptance_criteria: API endpoints for creating scheduled export, listing exports, and fetching export status implemented and documented
Worker can generate CSVs matching canonical schema v2.1 and upload artifacts to S3 with presigned download URLs
Webhook delivery implements HMAC_SHA256 signature, retries, and idempotency checks; tests cover success and transient failure cases
Export manifest includes column schema version, row count, byte size, compression flag, and checksum
Export artifacts are garbage-collected after configured retention and audit trail entries are created for every export action
Integration tests and contract tests with console UI hooks pass in staging; performance test for 100 concurrent tenant exports with <60s manifest generation for daily exports
